description: This file implements symmetric multiprocessing (SMP) support for the Zephyr RTOS kernel, including CPU startup, synchronization, and locking mechanisms.

methods.name: k_smp_cpu_start
methods.description: Starts a CPU with a specified initialization function and argument.

methods.name: k_smp_cpu_resume
methods.description: Resumes a CPU with specified initialization function, argument, and scheduling options.

methods.name: z_smp_init
methods.description: Initializes SMP by starting all CPUs and setting up synchronization.

methods.name: z_smp_global_lock
methods.description: Acquires a global lock for SMP operations.

methods.name: z_smp_global_unlock
methods.description: Releases the global lock for SMP operations.

methods.name: z_smp_release_global_lock
methods.description: Releases the global lock from within a thread.

methods.name: z_smp_cpu_mobile
methods.description: Checks if the current CPU is mobile (not pinned or in ISR).
